messages:
lucy: Hey team — starting Mon. Quick q's: 1) where/when do I pick up an access badge? 2) phishing sim — do I need to opt in or expect an email? 3) MDM + FileVault on my personal M2 Macbook — can I enroll now or do I need a company laptop? Thanks! :wave:

devon: Welcome Lucy!! :tada: Badge pickup is at reception (9–5 weekdays). Bring a photo ID, we'll mark you as 'active' before Monday. I'll add you to the access spreadsheet and cc facilities. For phishing sims you're auto-enrolled — it's part of onboarding, no opt-in. You'll get one or two test emails then a short follow-up training if needed.

ricardo: Hi Lucy — for MDM (we use Jamf) you'll get an invite to your work email. Typical steps: 1) open the Jamf enrollment link 2) install the MDM profile 3) enable FileVault and set a secure passcode. Quick mac checks you can run now: `fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type enrollment`. If you prefer, I can remote in during the day.

lucy: Thanks — I bought an M2 myself. Is that ok under personal-device policy? Any restrictions on versions?

ricardo: Personal devices are allowed if enrolled and encrypted. Requirements: macOS latest security patch, Jamf enrollment, FileVault turned on, automatic screen lock, and disk encryption. We don't force a corporate image, but we do push a managed profile and restrictions for corp data. VPN certs issued after enrollment.

sam: FYI re: phishing sims — they're low friction. If you fail the simulation you'll get a remediation module (~10 min). No disciplinary action. Also there's a security awareness drop-in Wed 10am; recommended but optional.

maria: welcome Lucy — hi! If you want a buddy for your first week I can pair with you on day 1 to cover sprint-setup and Slack perms.

security-bot: [phishsim] lucy@redwood.example added to campaign Spring-2026-Q2. Sim window: 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-12.

lucy: Awesome, thanks everyone. Quick follow: who do I ping if I lose my badge or if it doesn't activate? Also, enrollment emails will go to my work email once it exists, right?

devon: For lost/stolen badges use the `security-ops` channel or email security@redwood.example — they'll disable and reissue. Enrollment links use your company email; if you don't see them check spam and then ping ricardo here.

ricardo: If you want to pre-check tonight, run: `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status` and paste the outputs if anything looks off. If Jamf hasn't sent an invite by tomorrow morning DM me and I'll trigger it manually.

lucy: Will do the checks tonight and DM you if anything weird. Appreciate the quick answers — excited to join :grin:
